sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle. One angle measures 78°. Find the measure of the opposite angle.
An inscribed angle in a circle intercepts an arc of 34°. Find the measure of the inscribed angle.
A circle has radius 3. From an external point 5 from the centre, a tangent is drawn. Find the length of the tangent segment, and state the fact that makes this possible.
choices: 8, because the tangent extends beyond the circle
4, because the tangent bisects the radius
2, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency
4, because the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of tangency

items.prompt: A circle has radius 11. Find the arc length and the sector area for a central angle of 60°, in terms of π.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.
